rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the specific contributions of millisecond pulsars versus other sources to the gamma-ray flux of 47 Tuc or address the discrepancies in spectral properties. The closest paper, 2412.05220, is adjacent as it discusses gamma-ray emission from millisecond pulsars in globular clusters but not specifically in 47 Tuc.
